handoffRule: Every push/merge must regenerate current-platform-reconciliation.json. A changed module must have evidence, owner, new/modified paths, contract compatibility, CI link, merge SHA, blockers, and next permitted work. Use PRs as work units and merge only independently verified source. Do not claim clinical release.
approvalScope: Engineering source may be merged to main after functional gates; hospital deployment and clinical certification are separate.
